svg.title: Internal hostnames, animated
svg.desc: Your agent's Browser Run browser has three tabs. The example.com tab goes out to the public Internet. The preview.internal tab is routed through your Worker back to your agent, a Durable Object, and only this browser can reach it. Inside the agent, the Browser runs the host's fetch function with its target. The agent has three internal hosts: preview.internal, which the model points at port 5173 with browser.assignHost(), serves a dev server in the sandbox; site.internal, pointed at /workspace/dist, serves a workspace folder; and assets.internal always serves static assets from an R2 bucket. The api.internal tab goes straight to another Worker through a service binding, skipping your agent.

text.tspan: · runs each host's fetch with its target
